attempts.exactPrompt:
Create one original Summonlab candidate summon portrait as a cinematic semi-realistic painted drawing. Use visible brush planes and controlled illustrative detail: not a photograph, not photoreal skin, not plastic 3D, and not cel anime. Portrait canvas 1024 x 1536. Exactly one weaponless adult, full body, three-quarter standing pose, with the entire head, both hands, both feet, hair, clothing, and all accessories fully inside a generous safe margin. Warm pale parchment studio wash, restrained warm color response, soft grounding shadow, no environmental story.

New identity Calan Resheth: 20-year-old woman, 173 cm (medium), healthy slight, narrow, long-limbed construction with low mass, skin value band-3-light-medium. Face: soft rectangular face; wide-set eyes and a low straight brow; prominent bridge, compact mouth; subtle age lines. Calm closed-mouth neutral expression with no smile, grin, or theatrical acting.

Hair: red-copper-auburn, braids-twists-locs, deliberate accent: offset braid mass. Wardrobe: tailored-longcoat, specifically a cloth longcoat with a readable waist, split hem, plain underlayer, and fitted shoes; a high soft collar and uneven layered hems; bounded palette ochre-cream. Visible personal details: one small nape tattoo. Make a tattoo, scar, freckle field, or birthmark the primary recognition device. Maintenance cue: immaculate clothes over weathered hands. Color treatment: keeps color restrained to layered edges. Pose cue: weight settles into one heel, shoulders square, hands relaxed and completely visible. Include a bone-free wooden comb only as a quiet personal object, never as a weapon.

This is ordinary but intentionally designed 1-star mortal clothing. No weapon, armor, crown, magic, aura, or glow. No affinity cue, elemental gem, floating, frame, printed star, number, UI, logo, watermark, text, extra person, duplicated anatomy, cropped extremity, or published-character resemblance. Fantasy hair colors are matte dye or pigment, never supernatural emission. Preserve plausible anatomy while allowing the declared body construction to be extreme. Do not copy the reference's person, braid, clothes, pose, palette, progression, identity, body, hair, garments, ornaments, or markings.

RESERVE ACTIVATION: This is a fresh base summon, not an edit or regeneration of any existing hero. Create the new identity described above using only the authorized rendering-style reference. Honor the complete activated physical manifest and reserve character kernel; no failed hero or failed candidate is a visual source.

findings.observation: Original-resolution inspection shows exactly one adult woman with one coherent body and no duplicated anatomy.
The full head and offset braid mass, both relaxed hands, both fitted shoes, longcoat hems, and wooden comb remain wholly inside generous canvas margins.
Visible brush planes across skin, hair, fabric, and parchment staging establish a cinematic semi-realistic painted drawing rather than photography, plastic 3D, or cel anime.

Physique, palette, tailored split longcoat, high collar, uneven hems, fitted shoes, weathered hands, and wooden comb are legible, but the required single small nape tattoo is displaced to the side/front neck; dangling ear jewelry and multiple metallic braid rings are undeclared and exceed the one-detail manifest.
The compact mouth is closed and unsmiling; eyes and low brow remain calm and restrained without theatrical acting.

The subject remains a grounded ordinary mortal in cloth clothing with a quiet wooden comb and no weapon, armor, crown, magic, aura, affinity cue, glow, frame, star, number, UI, logo, watermark, or text.

Although face, copper color, physique, and tailored longcoat differ, the very long ringed braid draped over one shoulder reproduces the reference’s dominant hair silhouette and metallic ornament construction too closely for the strict non-transfer gate.

attempts.retryReason: Strict inspection rejected manifest fidelity and original identity. The orchestrator authorized exactly one call and no correction, so no corrective attempt was made.
